name: com.z-studio.unikit.ui.safearea
description: A uGUI safe-area layout component for Unity 6.0 and above. It supports adapting a container to the safe area based on specified edges, with custom padding, center alignment, and reference-direction mapping. It also supports expanding children outward or translating them while preserving their size, enabling layouts that extend into non-safe areas, and automatically updates in response to changes in window size, screen orientation, and the safe area.
